sections.excerpt:
DIVIDEND POLICY We do not have any present
plan to pay any cash dividends on our Ordinary Shares in the foreseeable future after this offering. We currently intend to retain most,
if not all, of our available funds and any future earnings to operate and expand our business. Our board of directors has
complete discretion in deciding the payment of any future dividends, subject to certain requirements of Cayman Islands law. Under Cayman
Islands law, a Cayman Islands company may pay a dividend out of either profit or share premium account, provided that in no circumstances
may a dividend be paid if this would result in the company being unable to pay its debts as they fall due in the ordinary course of business.
